ad_info.reference_style: Candid close-up of a relatable frustration moment, with a bold overlaid headline, the product as a small branded way-out tile and a gold offer plaque

global_identity.color_palette: Warm cream background #FBF3DC; lemon yellow #F2DC4A (product label, accents); metallic gold #C9A441 with lighter gold highlight #E6CF7A (day labels, offer plaque); near-black #111111 (headline and offer text); amber brown #8A4B14 (bottle glass); soft white #FFFFFF for panel fills and highlights.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bright beauty-supplement ad with a soft semi-illustrated realistic rendering of the model (smooth painterly digital illustration with realistic proportions and soft shading), on a light cream canvas with a tidy grid of progress panels.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Light, warm, feminine, optimistic and trustworthy; soft diffused daylight, no harsh shadows.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded-corner rectangular panels with a hairline pale-gold border, generous cream margins, a brushed metallic gold offer plaque with a thin inner border and rounded corners, a delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing behind the product, soft contact shadows under the product.
global_identity.text_typography: Typography of the reference: headline in a geometric sans-serif, extra-bold, all uppercase, solid near-black, centered, two lines, tight leading (Montserrat ExtraBold / Gotham Black style). Panel labels in the same geometric sans, bold, uppercase, metallic gold, small. Offer plaque: first line bold uppercase sans in black; middle line much larger, heavy condensed uppercase sans in black; third line regular-weight uppercase sans with wide letter spacing in black. No outlines, no shadows, no gradients on the text.

creative_objective: Make the viewer recognize her own moment in front of the mirror, in her own words, and present the drops and the 3-bottle offer as the daily support her routine may be missing.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The close-up of the woman holding the folded jeans at the mirror. 2) The white headline naming the problem. 3) The gold offer plaque at the bottom left. 4) The small lemon-yellow product tile at the bottom right. 5) The short subheadline.
art_direction.composition_style: Full-bleed composition. The camera is close, over her shoulder toward the bedroom mirror; the point of interest (her hands holding the folded jeans and her resigned expression in the reflection) sits in the center to lower-center, so the top-left area stays calmer and darker for the text, the bottom-right corner stays free for the product tile and the bottom-left for the offer plaque.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Text block in the top-left: starts at the 7% margin, spans at most 72% of the width and the top 40% of the height. Product tile: bottom-right, inset 6% from the right and bottom edges, about 26% of the width and 30% of the height. Offer plaque: bottom-left, from about 6% to 62% of the width and from about 76% to 94% of the height. The rest of the canvas is the scene, with no other graphics.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Natural window light in a bedroom, slightly cool and mildly desaturated, shallow depth of field with her face and hands in focus and the room softly blurred. A dark gradient (near-black at about 65% opacity fading to transparent) from the top-left corner gives the text contrast. The product tile and the gold plaque are the only warm, saturated elements.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas filled edge to edge with a candid close-up of a young woman at her bedroom mirror, seen from the shoulders up, holding a pair of folded jeans in her hands with a mildly resigned look. A dark diagonal gradient in the top-left corner holds a large white three-line headline and a short subheadline under it. In the bottom-right corner, a small rounded lemon-yellow tile contains the user's dropper bottle. In the bottom-left corner, a brushed gold offer plaque with three lines of black text.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 advertising image filled edge to edge with one candid, close scene, rendered in a soft semi-illustrated realistic style (smooth painterly digital illustration, realistic proportions, soft shading) that still feels real and everyday, not like a studio shot. SCENE: a bedroom with natural window light, slightly cool and mildly desaturated, softly blurred (a bed with light linen and a clothes rail far behind). The camera is close, over the shoulder, looking toward a bedroom mirror: in the reflection we see a Colombian woman of about 24 with a short bob haircut with honey highlights, wearing a grey sweatshirt, from the shoulders up. At chest height she holds a pair of folded blue jeans in both hands and looks at them with a mild, resigned half-smile, as if they did not fit the way she hoped. Her face and hands with the jeans are the sharp point of interest, placed in the center to lower-center of the frame. Show only the situation: never show her body below the chest and never zoom on any body part. The product does not appear in this scene. TOP-LEFT: a smooth dark gradient (near-black at about 65% opacity fading diagonally to fully transparent, with no hard edges and no box) covering about the top 45% and left 75% of the canvas. Over it, starting at a 7% margin and spanning at most 72% of the width, a large left-aligned headline in three lines, extra-bold geometric uppercase sans-serif, white, with only its last word in lemon yellow (#F2DC4A); directly below, a short regular-weight white supporting line in two rows. BOTTOM-RIGHT CORNER, inset 6% from the right and bottom edges: a small rounded-corner tile (about 26% of the width and 30% of the height) filled with lemon yellow (#F2DC4A), with a hairline pale-gold border and a soft drop shadow; centered inside it stands the product, front view, studio-lit, about 23% of the canvas height, its black dropper bulb rising slightly above the tile: a 60 ml amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper, the glass pipette visible inside the amber liquid, and a wraparound label with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom, showing the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark descriptor line, five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows and a small bottom line; the bottle is about 2.6 times taller than wide. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace, relabel or reinterpret it. BOTTOM-LEFT, from about 6% to 62% of the width and from about 76% to 94% of the height, not touching the tile: a brushed metallic gold rounded-corner plaque with a thin inner border and a subtle sheen, holding three centered lines of black uppercase text: a bold first line, a much larger heavy condensed middle line, and a regular-weight third line with wide letter spacing. The tile and the plaque are the only warm, saturated elements. No other graphics.
